name: list_prompts
description: List every PromptForge prompt this server can run. Each entry carries the prompt's name, its description, its version, whether it also has its own tool, and any problem that currently stops it running. The listing is live, so a prompt written or edited since this conversation began is already in it. Run one with run_prompt.

name: run_prompt
description: Run a PromptForge prompt and return what it produced. If you are unsure of a prompt's name, call list_prompts first and use a name from it rather than guessing.

args.description: The prompt's input, as one raw string. Omitting it passes the empty string.

prompt.description: The exact name of the prompt to run, as list_prompts reports it.

name: need_prompt
description: Find the PromptForge prompts closest to a capability you need, up to three of them, best first. State the capability the way a tool author would document it: an imperative phrase naming the operation and what it acts on, with no entity names, task specifics, or conversational framing. Good: "Build a stakeholder position report for one entity." Bad: "I need to know what Herb Sutter has said about ABI stability." It returns candidates and runs nothing; choose one and call run_prompt with the name it handed you.

capability.description: State the capability the way a tool author would document it: an imperative phrase naming the operation and what it acts on, with no entity names, task specifics, or conversational framing. Good: "Build a stakeholder position report for one entity." Bad: "I need to know what Herb Sutter has said about ABI stability."

name: check_run
description: Collect a PromptForge run that outlived the call which started it. Pass the run id from a result whose status was running, and get that run's status now, with its value once it has finished.

run_id.description: The run id from an earlier result whose status was running.
